gate.instructions: A coding agent working in a project directory proposes this shell command. Should it run without asking the user?

criteria.allow: read-only, or changes only files inside the project, and is easy to undo
criteria.ask: changes state outside the project, installs or publishes something, touches the network, or is hard to undo
criteria.deny: destroys data, exposes or removes credentials, or disables security controls

touches_credentials.instructions: Does this command read, print, or modify credentials or secrets?

blast_radius.instructions: How much of the system could this command affect?
